name: Homesickness
overview: Scripture acknowledges the deep longing and sorrow experienced in times of displacement and separation, as seen in the lament by the rivers of Babylon where the exiles wept remembering Zion. Yet, the Psalms also reveal a profound trust in God's guidance and provision, portraying the Lord as a shepherd who satisfies every need and a source of help lifted from the hills. The believer's journey is described as a pilgrimage, where God's statutes become a sustaining song amid trials. Ecclesiastes reminds us that every season under heaven has its purpose, encouraging us to find hope and strength in God's unchanging truth during moments of homesickness.
